facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent considering childproofing but unsure how to get started with installation. Use the available support claim without inventing ease, tools, compatibility or installation time.

variants.concept: Getting started: make one-to-one installation video support the answer to the first-step hesitation.
variants.primary_text: Want to childproof, but unsure where to begin with installation? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit brings together childproofing pieces for different parts of an Indian home, and includes 1-to-1 installation video support to help you get started. Explore the kit and its support as you plan your next step. Childproofing does not replace adult supervision.
variants.headline: A Child Safety Kit with Installation Video Support

variants.concept: Specific fitting question: focus on socket guards as a concrete part of the kit to consider.
variants.primary_text: Not sure how to approach installing socket guards? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes socket guards, plus 1-to-1 installation video support to guide you as you work through installation. It also includes other childproofing pieces for the home. Explore the kit for the product details. Childproofing is not a substitute for adult supervision.
variants.headline: Socket Guards, with 1-to-1 Installation Video Support

variants.concept: Price hesitation: pair the stated prepaid savings with the installation support available for getting started.
variants.primary_text: If you’re weighing the cost as well as how to get started, The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit has ₹299 prepaid savings. Unsure about installation? The kit also includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you have guidance to turn to as you work through setup. Childproofing does not replace adult supervision.
variants.headline: Save ₹299 Prepaid on the Child Safety Kit

internal_notes: The situations and motivations are creative hypotheses, not observed customer research.
Price and offer details reflect the supplied website observations; availability and policy eligibility details were not supplied.
